title: Two Jobs at Once
setup: Black's king has just come to a6, and the h-pawn looks four clear moves from queening.
hint: Do not choose between chasing its pawn and pushing your own — look for a route that does both.
explanation:
## The Idea

Chasing straight down the h-file is hopeless, so the king walks the diagonal, toward both pawns at once. If Black runs with {{h4}}, {{Kf6}} and then Ke6 bring the king next to d7, and your c-pawn queens just as Black's does. If Black goes for the c-pawn with {{Kb6}}, the same walk has gained the time to catch the h-pawn. Either way it is a draw.

This is Réti's study: a king on a diagonal can chase two things at once.
